newsitem.title: PAKISTAN: Pakistan Dec trade deficit falls to $160 mln.
newsitem.headline: Pakistan Dec trade deficit falls to $160 mln.

text.p: Pakistan's trade deficit fell to a provisional $160 million in December 1996 from $300 million in November 199, compared to $246 million in December 1995, the Federal Bureau of Statistics said Sunday.
Exports increased 19.9 percent to a provisional $800 million in December from $667 million in November, and increased 11.6 percent compared to $717 million in December 1995.
Imports decreased 0.7 percent to $960 million in December from $967 million in November 1996 and 0.3 percent compared to $963 million in December 1995.

The trade gap fell to a provisional $1.667 billion in the first six months of fiscal 1996/97 (July-June) from $1.991 billion in the year-ago period. Main exports were cotton yarn, fabrics, garments and rice. Main imports were machinery and petroleum products. -- N.Malik 9251-274757
